cases.summary: A narrow screen clips the submit control. Storage writes and account checks are unaffected.
At large text scale the label overlaps the answer field. No data mutation occurs.
Saving a draft deletes older persisted answers before the replacement transaction succeeds.
A success message appears after editing a word, but restarting restores the old value.
A catalog loads under a local data owner before optional AI connects. Context registration uses the absent AI session identity. Later connection cannot read that mounted catalog.
After switching accounts, the assistant can still read the previous learner progress from a mounted screen.
A delayed lookup invokes a widget update after the route has been disposed.
An older search request completes after the latest request and replaces the latest result.
The required feature is enabled in a test but disabled by its runtime configuration.
The optional integration endpoint is absent in runtime configuration and initialization reports it unavailable.
The report only says it failed. No steps, error, output, or expected behavior are available.
A user reports that something felt slow yesterday, without a screen, timing, trace, or reproduction.
